answer: Lagoon-settlement identity auction. Each agent identity must win a periodic slot auction; losing bidders forfeit deposits to winners. A zephyr of new clones floods bidding but raises clearing prices, so the marginal clone pays more than its expected task revenue. Enforce a terrace rule: identities below a reputation floor pay double clearing price, making each extra clone strictly negative-EV. Cost per clone is the auction premium plus forfeited deposits, scaling with clone count.
